local_review.finding_body: §FS-contribution-contract.2 requires a library-new-request contribution to target one new tested version. Base commit ec82d4358ee4f70a86e5b5f6fd38ad3303cba49d already contains org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-persistence:4.1.1 in index.json, introduced by merged PR #10437 (commit e0047dfe6f01d55e38f5dac965778bcb32c16174). The reviewed diff does not add a tested version or index entry; it only modifies the already-supported coordinate's tests, test-only metadata, and statistics. This cannot be repaired into a new-library contribution within the allowed files, so §FS-contribution-contract.5.5 requires maintainer intervention.
local_review.finding_title: Library-new request duplicates an already supported version
local_review.review_comment: The diff is confined to the target coordinate, uses only reachability-metadata.json, has non-scaffold public-API tests in a separate package with no version pinning, Native Image skip, compatibility override, or build/run flag, and the recorded 0/0 dynamic-access result is valid. The local gate record is successful. It cannot be approved as a library-new-request because the exact coordinate was already supported on the base branch.
